csv_project_name: Bldg 1 & 5 Commonwealth Tech Guaranteed Energy Savings
csv_scope_of_work: DGS is interested in contracting for a full range of energy services and energyrelated capital improvements ("energy conservation measures" or "ECMs") with no initial capital cost for the Project. The ECMs may include but are not limited to the design, acquisition, installation, modification, maintenance and training of Funding Agency personnel in the operation of existing and new equipment. The ECMs will reduce energy consumption and related costs associated with the heating, ventilation and air conditioning system, lighting systems, control systems, building envelope, the hot water systems, water consumption, sewage costs and other energy using devices. Additionally, savings which would not reduce consumption per se but are aimed at cost savings, such as fuel switching, demand side management, on-site generation, utility bill auditing, utility rate changes, and distribution upgrades etc. may also be considered. ECMs may also include training facility staff with respect to routine maintenance and operation of all improvements. ECMs must result in a guaranteed minimum energy savings with payments linked to actual documented energy and cost reductions.

title: Building 1 & 5 Commonwealth Tech Guaranteed Energy Savings
short_description: Energy savings performance project for two state buildings in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania.
project_scope: Guaranteed energy savings project for Buildings 1 and 5 at Commonwealth Tech. Scope includes energy conservation measures with no initial capital cost, potentially covering design, acquisition, installation, modification, maintenance, and staff training. Measures may affect HVAC systems, lighting, controls, building envelope, hot water systems, water consumption, sewage costs, and other energy-using devices. Additional cost-saving measures may include fuel switching, demand-side management, on-site generation, utility bill auditing, utility rate changes, and distribution upgrades. Payments are linked to documented energy and cost reductions.
services: Design-build/developer and energy engineering services for a guaranteed energy savings contract, including design, procurement, installation, modification, maintenance, and training.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an energy performance and MEP-focused building retrofit project.
- Scope centers on HVAC, lighting, controls, utilities, and operational savings rather than structural engineering.
- No indication of complex load-bearing structures, bridges, roofs, façades, or architecturally demanding structural design.
- Falls under project types explicitly of low interest to sbp: MEP/building services and energy engineering.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The project is structured as a guaranteed energy savings contract with no initial capital cost, but no investment volume, building size, or ECM budget is provided.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As the tender is for design-build/developer and energy engineering services within an energy savings performance contract, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Bidders are sought for design-build/developer and energy engineering disciplines. No explicit minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided source.
